_comment: THE MUSIC BED. DECLARED HERE, NEVER INFERRED FROM THE DIRECTORY.
Every clip this pipeline renders is silent, and a silent post costs reach
on both platforms. On TikTok that was survivable: the clip lands in your
inbox and you add a sound in the app before posting. A Reel does not wait
for anybody, it publishes the moment you approve, and a Reel's audio
cannot be changed afterwards. So the file itself has to carry a track.
WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT JUST A FOLDER.
src/video/tracks.js reads THIS LIST, not the directory. A file sitting in
assets/audio that is not named here is ignored, by design and loudly: the
one thing that can go wrong with a music bed is publishing something we do
not have the right to publish, and 'whatever happens to be in the folder'
is exactly the rule that lets a file somebody dropped in to listen to
become the soundtrack of a post. Same argument as the TikTok verified-
domain list in src/publish/imageHosts.js: deriving 'allowed' from
'present' makes the check agree with any mistake it was written to catch.
EVERY ENTRY MUST DECLARE ITS LICENCE AND WHERE IT CAME FROM. A track with
either missing is refused with its filename, at load, rather than being
quietly skipped, because a skipped track is a silent post and that is the
thing being fixed.
WHAT TO PUT HERE, AND THE WARNING THAT COMES WITH IT.
CC0 or an explicit commercial-use-no-attribution licence. The safe sources
are the ones that exist for this: Pixabay Audio, Uppbeat, the Free Music
Archive's CC0 shelf, YouTube Audio Library downloads.
A LICENCE IS NOT THE SAME AS PASSING AUDIO MATCHING. Instagram and TikTok
both fingerprint audio, and a legitimately licensed track that a rights
holder has also registered can still get a Reel muted or region-blocked.
That is not a licensing failure and there is nothing in a manifest that
can prevent it. The practical defence is to prefer tracks from libraries
built for social posting, and to check the first post under any new track
by hand before it joins the rotation.
EMPTY IS A VALID STATE AND IT MEANS SILENCE. Nothing here breaks with no
tracks; clips render exactly as they did before. bot.js says so at boot
and the approval card says so per clip, because a silent clip and a
sounded one are indistinguishable in a Telegram preview you are about to
tap approve on.
FIELDS:
file     filename inside assets/audio (or AUDIO_DIR). Required.
title    what it is called, for the approval card. Required.
credit   who made it. Required, even when the licence does not ask for
attribution, because 'no attribution required' is a permission
and not a reason to stop recording where something came from.
licence  the licence, as a string you could defend. Required.
source   the page it was downloaded from. Required.
mood     optional free text, for your own sorting. Unused by the code.
